Summary: Do not steal by stealth — quietly taking what is not yours, even where no force is used.
Application: Stealth does not soften theft; it is theft's ordinary form, the quiet taking that hopes nobody will notice. The command names the secret taking alongside open robbery, so that no thief can plead that he took gently.
Purpose: TRADITIONAL reading: taking by stealth is theft no less than taking by force, and is forbidden as such (Leviticus 19:11).
